label: Drop column cip_cap from obra_residentes
summary: Elimina la columna "cip_cap" de "obra_residentes" (sin uso en el contrato ni en el código)

precheck.description: ensure column cip_cap exists and holds no data
precheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (   SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns   WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'obra_residentes' AND column_name = 'cip_cap' ) AND NOT EXISTS (   SELECT 1 FROM "public"."obra_residentes" WHERE "cip_cap" IS NOT NULL ) AS "result"

postcheck.description: verify column cip_cap no longer exists
postcheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (   SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns   WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'obra_residentes' AND column_name = 'cip_cap' ) AS "result"
